notes.title: Diamond Skee-ball Announcement
notes.content:
We are currently running beta on the following channels for Diamond Skee-Ball.

SubmainFun (Twitch Channel)

CPW_skeeball (Twitch Channel)

Oneira Levantas (Twitch Channel)

Skitsylum (Twitch Channel)

Some Channels may NOT be live but drop them a follow for when they do go live

Pop on over and use the following commands:


Use the command 
 !roll [power 1 to 5] [startingPost -5 to 5] [rotation -30 to 30]" to join the que.

 EG: !roll 5 5 30


!help (this will tell you what you need to do aswell)

Add to your wishlist to be notified when we have the release open.
